findings.text: the first done-when now measures families on the live census §10 delivers (family-wording-pass.json: family_count 23, member_count 316, families_at_one_wording_before 0; the section's own closing census records 23 of 23 divergent), yet requires that count to be laid "beside the counts before the first write: 8 forms for the flux-surface average and 20 of 20 species families divergent among the published names", a different cohort — 20 of 20 is the published census of families with three or more members in v0.4.0rc8 (plan.html:39, 281 members; published-family-census.txt line 132 "families with >1 description template or unit: 20 of 20"), and rewrite-closing-census.json itself stores that figure as before_family_baseline "20 of 20 (published-family-census.txt)" while its live arm counts 23 families; the operator figure in the same clause shifts cohort the same way, since §1's 8 forms is counted over 32 published flux-surface-averaged names while the live census counts 71 names naming that operator (rewrite-closing-census.json phases.live.operator_phrases.flux_surface_averaged.names_naming_the_operator)
